lines.quote: The prayers of good people got Donald Trump elected two weeks ago.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: A story about why Trump won, saying nothing about the state of the war or the economy.

lines.quote: Wars with Russia and Iran are the counterattack.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Frames war with Iran as the course being pushed against the new president, which leads away from the no-war state.

lines.quote: Mark Levin was at the White House today, lobbying for war with Iran.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Names who is pushing for war, which is a question of blame and loyalties.

lines.quote: there is zero credible intelligence that suggests Iran is anywhere near building a bomb
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Disputes the stated case for war, so the war course lacks grounds.

lines.quote: young Americans heading back to the Middle East to topple yet another government
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Says the real aim of the course being pushed is a regime-change war with US troops.

lines.quote: The first week of a war with Iran could easily kill thousands of Americans.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Names the cost in American dead of a war that men are lobbying for; the dead are counted, never scored.

lines.quote: It could also collapse our economy, as surging oil prices trigger unmanageable inflation.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: A mechanism from war to oil to inflation, reading the cost hard.

lines.quote: Consider the effects of $30 gasoline.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Extrapolates an extreme pump price as the cost of the war course.

lines.quote: An attack on Iran could very easily become a world war. We'd lose.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: could very easily become a world war
lines.why: Reads the war course as escalating through Iran's allies into a lost world war.

lines.quote: A war with Iran would amount to a profound betrayal of his supporters. It would end his presidency.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Says war would cost Trump his support, a cost of the course being pushed.

lines.quote: The one thing that people like Mark Levin don't want is a peaceful solution
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: don't want is a peaceful solution
lines.why: Attributes motives to named people, a blame line.

lines.quote: Pray that Donald Trump ignores them.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: Pray that Donald Trump ignores them
lines.why: A prayer that takes no stand on where things stand.

lines.quote: The real divide is between those who casually encourage violence, and those who seek to prevent it — between warmongers and peacemakers.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: A moral split between camps, not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: On that list: Sean Hannity, Mark Levin, Rupert Murdoch, Ike Perlmutter and Miriam Adelson.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: will all have to answer for this
lines.why: Names people to blame for pressing for US involvement.

lines.quote: how the president's enemies are working to destroy MAGA with the war on Iran
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: A teaser pointing at who is behind the push, a blame frame.

lines.quote: Senator Ted Cruz demands regime change in Iran. He's not interested in the details.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: Targets a named senator's position and carelessness rather than a reading of the object.

lines.quote: Thank God.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: A bare expression of relief that gives no reading of the war's state.

lines.quote: Thank God Trump brokered a ceasefire.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: He welcomes the end of the fighting after the US strikes, which reads as relief that the no-war promise is partly restored.

lines.quote: That's the last thing Mark Levin wanted.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: It speaks to what a named person wanted, not to the state of the war.

lines.quote: Our interview with the president of Iran.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: interview with the president of Iran
lines.why: It is a teaser that names a topic and says nothing about how things stand.

lines.quote: This is Israel's last chance to blow up Iran with America's military
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: last chance to blow up Iran
lines.why: He describes a push to pull the US into war with Iran, so the line carries the logic of that course, which leads to the war.

lines.quote: naturally the neocons have reached peak hysteria
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lines.why: It assigns blame to a camp and its temperament, not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: So mightily spread abroad your Spirit, that all peoples may be gathered under the banner of the Prince of Peace

lines.why: It is a prayer for peace that says nothing about the state of the war.

lines.quote: Israel's war and what it means.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson

lines.quote: Could this be a religious war designed to rebuild the Third Temple on the ashes of Al Aqsa? Hope not.

lines.why: It is a speculative question paired with a hope, and it does not say where things stand.

lines.quote: how this war changes American politics forever

lines.why: A guest teaser that names a topic and takes no side on where the war stands.

lines.quote: Pray that the spell breaks and the world is saved.

lines.quote: it should be illegal to yoke our military to a foreign power in war

lines.quote: Bret Weinstein on how it happened.

lines.quote: why we actually went to war with Iran

lines.quote: ground troops are often followed by tyranny in the country that sends them

lines.quote: We're spending more a year on the military in adjusted dollars than we did during World War II.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: spending more a year on the military
than we did during World War II

lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: What are we getting for it
how much is going to Israel

lines.quote: the Trump administration may be within days of launching a nuclear strike on Iran
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson, reporting on the administration
lines.why: It says the war is about to escalate to a nuclear strike, the worst step for the war itself.

lines.quote: Netanyahu is cornered and desperate.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson on Netanyahu
lit: Bibi calls Trump about it every day
lines.why: It puts the blame for the war on Netanyahu's motives and his hold on Trump, not on any reading of the object.

lines.quote: Gulf economies are teetering. So are global energy and fertilizer markets.

lines.why: It describes energy markets as damaged by eight months of war.

lines.quote: In October alone, 11 of them were badly damaged in Hormuz. At this pace, a global depression is imminent.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: 11 of them were badly damaged in Hormuz
lines.why: It traces tanker losses to a coming global depression, a forecast of severe economic damage.

lines.quote: After the first nuclear strike, World War Three is inevitable.
lines.subject: Tucker Carlson
lit: free them to use nuclear weapons

a deal with Iran can be made
